insight: Berlin-founded; a $350M General Catalyst-led Series D in January 2026 tripled its valuation to $3B in eight months.
name: Parloa
tagline: AI Agent Management Platform for enterprise contact centers, voice-first and multilingual.
description: An enterprise platform for running AI customer-service agents at contact-center scale, with particular depth in voice and phone automation. Its Agent Management Platform (AMP) covers the full agent lifecycle — design, simulation testing, scaling, and optimization — handling tasks like ID verification, billing inquiries, and order management in any language. Customers include Allianz, Booking.com, SAP, and Swiss Life.

modelSupport.notes: Multi-model approach across LLM providers for contextual agents.

edge: Voice-first depth most support AI peers lack — a full agent lifecycle platform built for enterprise phone volume, not just chat deflection.
cons: Heavier lift than plug-and-play helpdesk bots

references.title: Parloa triples its valuation in 8 months to $3B with $350M raise
